strategies.name: MOM_VIX
strategies.thesis: Applying a VIX-based regime filter to the existing momentum strategy can reduce MDD and improve PF.
strategies.signal_construction: Long top-5 momentum stocks when VIX < 20, otherwise cash
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Incorporates VIX regime filter to reduce MDD
strategies.fail_mode: VIX filter fails to reduce MDD

strategies.name: MOM_YC
strategies.thesis: Using a yield-curve based regime filter can improve the momentum strategy's performance.
strategies.signal_construction: Long top-5 momentum stocks when 10y-2y yield curve > 0, otherwise cash
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Incorporates yield-curve regime filter to improve PF
strategies.fail_mode: Yield curve filter fails to improve PF

strategies.name: MOM_VOL
strategies.thesis: Implementing a volatility-targeting approach can reduce MDD and improve the strategy's overall performance.
strategies.signal_construction: Long top-5 momentum stocks with volatility < 20%, otherwise cash

mdd_reduction_techniques: Volatility-targeting: cap position size based on stock-specific volatility
Regime-filtering: use VIX or yield-curve to determine market regime and adjust strategy accordingly
Friction-aware position sizing: reduce position size to minimize trading costs and slippage
live_to_offline_gap_diagnoses: Lack of regime-filtering or volatility-targeting in live strategy
Inadequate handling of trading costs and slippage in live strategy
killers: Existing live EQUITY emitter with PF 1.58
single_most_important_finding: Incorporating regime-filtering and volatility-targeting techniques can significantly improve the momentum strategy's performance and reduce MDD.
